nodes.label: Start
Input: n (int), maxDistance (int), roads (List of List of int)
nodes.action: ctx['n'] = ctx['arg0']; ctx['maxDistance'] = ctx['arg1']; ctx['roads'] = ctx['arg2']; ctx['ans'] = 0

nodes.label: Iterate over i from 0 to 2^n - 1 (bitmask representing closed branches)
Is i < 2^n?
Initialize g as a matrix with dimensions n x n, filled with infinity
Iterate through each road (x, y, w) in roads
Are both branches x and y active in bitmask i?
Set g[x][y] and g[y][x] to the minimum of their current value and w
nodes.action: ctx['x'] = ctx['roads'][ctx['road_idx']][0]; ctx['y'] = ctx['roads'][ctx['road_idx']][1]; ctx['w'] = ctx['roads'][ctx['road_idx']][2]; ctx['g'][ctx['x']][ctx['y']] = min(ctx['g'][ctx['x']][ctx['y']], ctx['w']); ctx['g'][ctx['y']][ctx['x']] = min(ctx['g'][ctx['y']][ctx['x']], ctx['w'])

nodes.label: Set g[i][i] = 0 for each j in range(n)
Apply Floyd-Warshall algorithm to calculate shortest paths
nodes.action: for k in range(ctx['n']): for i in range(ctx['n']): for j in range(ctx['n']): ctx['g'][i][j] = min(ctx['g'][i][j], ctx['g'][i][k] + ctx['g'][k][j])

nodes.label: Initialize ok = 1 (flag to check maxDistance constraint)
Iterate over each pair of branches (j, k)
Are both branches j and k active in bitmask i?
Is g[j][k] <= maxDistance?
Do nothing
Keep ok = 1
Set ok = 0
Is ok == 1?
Increment ans by 1
Do nothing
Output: ans (total number of valid sets)

verification.note: 确认 ILR 错误：一是图结构残缺——road 循环无 road_idx 递增、(j,k) 循环无 j/k 递增，节点18(ok判断)与节点21(end)均不可达，忠实执行会死循环；二是语义错误——节点7/13 用 (x & i)==0 判断分支活跃，把分支编号 x 同时当作位掩码用（应为 (i>>x)&1）。生成代码忠实复刻了 (x & i) 语义并对循环做了必要的可执行化重构，失败完全由 ILR 缺陷导致。
verification.evidence: 按图模拟在节点 6→7→8 死循环（road_idx 恒为 0）；生成代码在示例1 (n=3, maxD=5) 得 4 而非 5——i=1（关闭分支0）时道路[1,2,10] 因 (1&1)!=0 被错误跳过致 g[1][2]=inf；100 条测试失败 75 条。
